question: Which of the following diseases is caused by the deficiency of Vitamin A?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Night blindness__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
